summary: Nayax Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a supplemental proxy statement for its postponed Annual General Meeting. The filing revises certain proposals (2,3,4,7,8,9,10) and withdraws Proposal 11 following shareholder and proxy advisor feedback. The board recommends voting FOR revised proposals. No special situation (acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, etc.) is present; the filing is a routine proxy update for an annual meeting.
